title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: A job for every player
hook: Does every kid on your team know their job?
intro: Some players touch the ball all game.
statement: A clear job makes every player part of the game.
q1: Do you give each player one specific job —
q2: or keep it simple and let them play?
q3: Which players drift when they have no job?
t1: No single answer fits every team. But kids stay involved
t2: when they know what they are responsible for.
cta: Coaches — how do you give out jobs?
ctaLines: Mark one player. Talk on defense. Bring the ball up.
ctaPrompt: Share your team habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Does every kid on your team know their job?
Some players touch the ball all game. Others drift and wait.
A clear job makes every player part of the game.
One clear job each or free play. Both can work.
How do you give out jobs? Share your habit in the comments.
